technical.summary: ORLY displays strong multi-timeframe bullish structure with price above all major MAs and rising RSI across all periods, but elevated momentum indicators (RSI 9 at 69.62, Stoch K at 78.33) and conflicting MACD signals suggest caution on immediate entry; better suited for pullback entry or confirmation of breakout.

fundamental.summary: ORLY shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 36 days—insufficient smart money alignment for a bullish thesis.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Kevin Hern's recent large purchase ($15-50K, Oct 2021) suggests insider confidence, but broad market sentiment is neutral with no news data to confirm conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (286) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 36 days adds moderate event risk; macro score -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.
